summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging in Shahjamal and along Ramghat and Khair Road, power tripping on Khair Road, Sasni Gate and Ramghat, and daily tripping hitting Talanagari factories; appreciation is limited to a Khair Road road under construction and a few pump and drain fixes.

positives.english: Three new high-capacity pumps are running to drain Shahjamal rainwater
positives.hindi: शाहजमाल का पानी निकालने के लिए तीन नए पंप चल रहे हैं
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (5 Aug 2026): the corporation decided to install three pumps of 10,000 litres per minute each, reported running by late night, adding about 30,000 litres per minute of drainage capacity; the Municipal Commissioner called freeing the Shahjamal area from waterlogging the top priority. The article does not name the pumping station site. Shahjamal polling parts are on the AC 76 ERO/AERO list (parts 146, 150-156, 185), so AC membership is confirmed

sources.outlet: Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in)

positives.english: Khair Road's Rs 29 crore road is under construction, but work is slow
positives.hindi: खैर रोड की सड़क बन रही है, पर काम धीमा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 May 2026): road from Hiralal ki puliya to Nada Pul chauraha on Khair Road under the CM Grid scheme, about Rs 29.58 crore; the Municipal Commissioner fined the contractor PPS Builders Rs 20 lakh for slow progress; streetlight pole fitting had not started; no completion date given. Under construction, not completed. Khair Road polling parts (AC 76 list parts 19-24 and 128-129) are in AC 76 only

sources.outlet: Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in)

positives.english: Bad road in Panchavati Colony began being rebuilt after a student's video
positives.hindi: पंचवटी कॉलोनी की खराब सड़क छात्र के वीडियो के बाद बननी शुरू हुई
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (14 Aug 2026): after a Panchavati Colony student posted a video of the road on 29 Jul 2026, the Nagar Nigam started work at about Rs 45 lakh in ward 24 (Devsaini area), with a two-month target. Construction started, not completed. The article names no assembly constituency. District-level item: Panchavati Colony is on neither the AC 76 nor the AC 75 ERO/AERO list, so AC membership is unconfirmed

positives.english: A small substation near UPCDA is being used to cut tripping in Talanagari
positives.hindi: तालानगरी में ट्रिपिंग कम करने के लिए छोटा सब-स्टेशन चालू है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): XEN Rahul Katihar said a small substation near UPCDA is an alternative arrangement (वैकल्पिक इंतजाम) to reduce tripping in Talanagari; a permanent site is still being sought. The article names no assembly constituency. Talanagari is on neither the AC 76 nor the AC 75 ERO/AERO list, so AC membership is unconfirmed; district-level item

positives.english: *A faulty pump was repaired in the waterlogged Shahjamal area
positives.hindi: *शाहजमाल में खराब पंप ठीक हो गया है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (4 Aug 2026) quotes the Water Department general manager that a faulty pump has been repaired, in a report on Shahjamal waterlogging. The article does not say which pump or station it is, or confirm that it is in the Shahjamal area. Field check needed

negatives.english: Shahjamal streets stay waterlogged with dirty water for several days
negatives.hindi: शाहजमाल में कई दिनों से सड़क पर गंदा पानी भरा रहता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (4 Aug 2026): waterlogging for several days on a route in Shahjamal; on Monday people had to walk through dirty water and a vehicle carried the procession's alam. Shahjamal, Babri Mandi, Phool Chauraha and Charkhwalan Chauraha are named. The Water Department general manager said a faulty pump was repaired and a new 1,000 kilolitre pumping station (about Rs 16 crore) is proposed at Charkhwalan Chauraha. AC membership: Shahjamal parts are on the AC 76 ERO/AERO list (parts 146, 150-156, 185)

sources.outlet: Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in)

negatives.english: Rain water gets into shops on Ramghat and Khair Road
negatives.hindi: रामघाट और खैर रोड पर बारिश में दुकानों तक पानी घुस जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jul 2026, city-level reporting): the drains report lists localities along the Ramghat Road route where water enters homes and shops (including Shahjamal Eidgah Road, Gular Road and Khair Road); Gular Road, Khair Road and Melrose Bypass were still waterlogged 36 hours after Wednesday's rain. AC membership: Khair Road parts (AC 76 list parts 19-24 and 128-129) are in AC 76 only; Ramghat Road has parts in both AC 76 (parts 110-112) and AC 75 Koil, so the Ramghat stretch is shared. The flooding list is city-level, not AC-only

sources.outlet: Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in)

negatives.english: Power keeps going off and tripping on Khair Road, Sasni Gate and Ramghat
negatives.hindi: खैर रोड, सासनी गेट और रामघाट में बिजली बार-बार जाती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Aug 2026): power went off in the Khair Road area around 10 PM; residents of Sasni Gate, Medical Road and others had no supply for hours; resident Satish Maheshwari said power had been tripping repeatedly since morning in ADA Colony, Avantika Phase-1 and Ramghat Road and warned appliances could be damaged. The Superintending Engineer (Urban) said teams were sent and supply restored. AC membership: Khair Road (AC 76 parts 19-24, 128-129) and Sasni Gate (parts 321-328) are on the AC 76 ERO/AERO list, and not on the AC 75 list. Medical Road is on neither list and is not counted

sources.outlet: Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in)

negatives.english: Power tripping every day in Talanagari, factories lose production
negatives.hindi: तालानगरी में रोज़ बिजली ट्रिप होती है, फैक्ट्रियों का काम रुकता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): tripping has become a daily problem in the Talanagari industrial area, where more than 1,000 factories operate; supply comes from a 132 kVA substation at Bounar about 11 km away; a new substation has been sought for three years without a site. The article names no assembly constituency. Talanagari is on neither the AC 76 nor the AC 75 ERO/AERO list, so AC membership is unconfirmed and this item is not counted as AC-specific

negatives.english: Power cuts on Ramghat Road also left people short of drinking water
negatives.hindi: रामघाट रोड पर बिजली गई तो पीने के पानी की भी दिक्कत हुई
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Aug 2026): supply was cut from morning to late night on Friday; Choudhary Vihar-Ramghat Road was among the affected areas; the article says the outage also caused a drinking water shortage; the Superintending Engineer (Urban) said supply was restored once faults were fixed. The Maris Road feeder is not used here, because Maris Road polling parts are in AC 75 (Koil). Ramghat Road parts are in both AC 76 and AC 75, and the article does not say which stretch, so AC membership is unconfirmed and this item is not counted as AC-specific

round2.changes: Fetched and checked every cited URL; corrected bases where the article did not say what was claimed (pumps not stated as installed at a named station; 'temporary' removed from substation wording; Choudhary Vihar-Ramghat Road not linked to Qila station; Talanagari VCB claim removed as unverified). Removed Siyakhas (Jawan block, outside AC 76) and the utility-restoration positive (utility statement, not a voter benefit). Replaced Quarsi negative (Quarsi polling parts are in AC 75 Koil) and Medical Road/Maris Road claims (Maris Road is in AC 75). Added Shahjamal Karbala-route waterlogging negative (Amar Ujala 4 Aug 2026) and Khair Road road-construction positive (Amar Ujala 22 May 2026). Replaced positive inference (Siyakhas) with a sourced Shahjamal item and a flagged Shahjamal pump inference. Added AC 76 ERO/AERO polling-part list (aligarh.nic.in, 2026) as the membership source; Shahjamal, Ramghat Road, Khair Road, Sasni Gate and Gular Road parts confirmed in AC 76; Dodpur and Jamalpur (earlier notes said AC 76) are in AC 75 Koil.

notes: AC 76 'Aligarh' (ECI number as printed on the 2026 ERO/AERO list), reserved None, Aligarh district, Aligarh Lok Sabha. Identity confirmed on Wikipedia. The Wikipedia page gives no extent, so membership rests on the 2026 ERO/AERO polling-part list for AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in B.L.O. list page, last updated 13.10.2026; PDF text extracted locally: 394 AC 76 parts). Correction to the previous draft: the earlier NIC citation (AC number 357, updated 22 Nov 2025) could not be re-verified; the current list prints AC 76 and it is the basis used here. Localities confirmed in AC 76: Shahjamal (incl. ADA Colony), Khair Road / Khair Bypass Road, Sasni Gate, Gular Road, Achal Talab, Turkman Gate, Nagla Masani. Ramghat Road has parts in both AC 76 and AC 75. Localities in AC 75 Koil, not AC 76: Quarsi, Maris Road, Dodpur, Jamalpur. Not found in either list, so unconfirmed: Talanagari, Panchavati Colony (ward 24), Swarn Jayanti Nagar, Medical Road, Begpur, Jaigunj. Field check: confirm Talanagari and Panchavati Colony AC membership, and whether the Ramghat Road stretch named in the Aug 2026 outage reports is in AC 76 or AC 75. Searches for further completed AC 76 projects (roads, drains, substations in Ramghat, Sasni Gate, Turkman Gate, Achal Talab) found no verifiable 2026 completion report; the positives list is thin and includes items that are under construction or flagged. The Oct 2026 drainage project (Rs 105 crore, approved Aug 2026) was not used as a positive: it is an approval, not a delivered benefit. The 14 Aug 2026 Panchavati ETV date is taken from the URL slug and was not re-read on the page.
